44 Years. One Auburn Township Yard. Two Generations of Roubic Family Tree Care.

Founder Thomas Roubic. Owner-operator {{global.owner_name}} since 2017. A tenured 3-person field crew including 10-year foreman Doug Battiest. Same yard at 10840 Taylor May Rd since 1982 — no franchising, no reshuffling, no chain-of-command layers between you and the person removing your tree.

How Roubic Started · 1982

One Truck. One Chainsaw. One Auburn Community.

Thomas Roubic founded Roubic Tree Service in 1982 with a single pickup truck and a single chainsaw. Auburn was his hometown, and the Auburn community gave him his start in the trade.

The first official Roubic job was clearing the road for Auburn Lakes — a single contract that turned into a referral, then another, then a steady stream of work across the rural Geauga County corridor and into Cuyahoga County.

Tom led Roubic for 35 years, taking the company from a single-truck startup through equipment expansions, a major out-of-state storm response in 1997 (Hurricane Danny cleanup in North Carolina), and a steadily widening service area across Greater Cleveland.

The Auburn community gave me my start. Every job we did in the first ten years was somebody's neighbor calling somebody's neighbor. That's still how it works. Thomas Roubic · Founder

Semi-retired since 2017. Still consults on operations.

The Second Generation · 2009 → present

Tom's Son. Owner-Operator. Every Job Site, Every Time.

2009 Joined full-time 2017 Took over daily ops

{{global.owner_name}}, Tom's son, joined the business full-time in 2009 after leaving Hiram College. He spent eight years working alongside his father — climbing techniques, proper chainsaw technique, and how to perform both safely and efficiently — before taking over daily operations in 2017.

Today, Aaron handles all sales and the daily operations of every job site. Tom still consults on the business, and the same Roubic family ownership that started in 1982 is still in place.

I visit every job site. That's the difference. It's my name on the truck. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

That continuity matters: when you call Roubic, you're not navigating a chain of franchises or a rotating regional manager.

1982
Founded

Roubic Tree Service Founded

Thomas Roubic starts the business with a single pickup truck and a single chainsaw at 10840 Taylor May Rd, Auburn Township — the same yard we still operate from today.

1982

The first official Roubic contract cleared the road for the Auburn Lakes community. That single job turned into a referral, then another, and the business grew from there.

1997

Roubic crews deployed out of state for Hurricane Danny cleanup — the first major test of the equipment fleet and the crew's ability to work storm-response scale.

What We Stand For

Six Things That Make Roubic Different

Owner-Led

Aaron visits every job site. Not a project manager. Not a franchise operator. The owner walks your property, gives you the estimate, and answers his phone.

Same Yard Since 1982

10840 Taylor May Rd, Auburn Township. No franchising. No moves. No reshuffling. The same community, the same address, for 44 years.

ANSI A300 Standards

Every cut follows the Tree Care Industry Association specification. Not shortcut trimming. Not hack-and-run pruning that damages the tree.

Owned Equipment Fleet

Bandit chipper, tracked grinder, John Deere skid, crane access — all owned. No rental gap on job day. No subcontracting on core work.

Tenured Field Crew

Doug Battiest, 10-year foreman. Mitchel Battiest, 2 years. Dallas Chapman, apprentice groundman. Not day-labor. Not a rotating gig-worker roster.

Insurance-Doc Storm Response

Common Questions About Roubic

About Roubic — FAQ

Six of the questions we hear most about the business — with straight answers, not sales copy.

How long has Roubic been in business?
Roubic Tree Service was founded in 1982 by Thomas Roubic and has been continuously family-operated for 44 years. The company has occupied the same 10840 Taylor May Rd yard in Auburn Township for that entire span. {{global.owner_name}} — Tom's son — took over daily operations in 2017.
Who owns Roubic Tree Service now?
{{global.owner_name}} has been owner-operator since 2017. Founder Thomas Roubic is semi-retired but still consults on operations, equipment decisions, and complex removals. Ownership has remained in the Roubic family since founding.
Is Roubic insured?
Yes — Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC carries general liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage. Certificates and policy details are available on request, and are included in the insurance-documentation packet delivered on every storm / tree-on-structure job.
Does {{global.owner_name}} personally visit every job site?
Yes. Every free estimate is walked in person by Aaron or by lead foreman Doug Battiest. Every job runs under direct Roubic supervision — no subcontractors, no franchise operators, no rotating regional managers. If Aaron writes the estimate, Aaron is on-site the day of the work.
Is Roubic hiring?
We hire selectively. If you have tree-care experience — climbing, chainsaw operation, chipper work, or groundman work — and you're looking to work under a 10-year foreman with a tenured crew, call the office at {{global.phone}} or email info@{{global.domain}}.
What areas does Roubic serve?
Roubic serves 13 NE Ohio cities within a 40-mile radius of Auburn Township. Tier 1 (priority response): Auburn Township HQ, Pepper Pike, Chagrin Falls, Moreland Hills, Solon. Tier 2 (2-day scheduling): Gates Mills, Beachwood, Orange, Bainbridge Township, Shaker Heights. Tier 3: Chesterland, Mayfield, South Russell. See the Service Areas page for full details.
